units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 19:1">Targ. Prov. XIX, 1</cite>, a. fr. in Ms., ed. Lag. <cite ref="E00218"><he>הֲווֹ</he></cite> q. v.—Pesik. Aḥaré, p. 169ᵇ, v. <cite ref="D00404"><he>דְּחוּכָא</he></cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:20">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵃ</cite> <he>היך … להן וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:10:4">Y. Succ. III, 54ᵃ</cite> top <he>לדין</he>), v. <cite ref="E00374"><he>הֵיךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:11">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> top [read:] <he>מה הן שאל להן וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:12">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> top <he>מה הין דשאיל להון</he> (corr. acc.) from all that this one asked that one &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: what? Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ לְהָן, v. אֲהָן.
where (relat.), where? Esth. R. to I, 12 [read:] הן דליסטאה מקפח וכ׳ where the robber waylays, there he is executed.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:33">Y. Snh. I, 19ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8:13">Y. Ned. VI, 40ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הן דמטא מטא</he> where he came to, he came to (and his order was obeyed).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:11">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>להן דאשתלחית מינסבינן</he> to the place whither I was sent to take them; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:14">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵇ</cite> <he>להון דשלחית</he> (read <he>דאשתלחית</he>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:3">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>בְּרָא</he></cite>.
Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ bot. להן ייזיל whither shall he go? Ib. II, 5ᵃ top מן הן הוא where is he from?; a. fr.—Pl. הַנְהוּ, הַנֵּי, הַנָּךְ those, these.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:10">Targ. Esth. I, 10</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 6a:15-16">Gitt. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>הנך … דהני והני בדהנך וכ׳</he> those (the inhabitants of Ctesiphon) know the signatures of these (of Ardshir), but the latter do not know &c.
Bets. 10ᵇ; a. v. fr.—*Fem. pl. הַנָּן.

Y. Bets. V, 63ᵇ top רבנין … מפרשין לה׳ the Rabbis of Cæsarea report these (controversies) more explicitly (stating the opinion of each by name; Y. Pes. VIII, 36ᵃ top מפרשין להון).—הני מילי (abbrev. הנ״מ) these words (have been said), i.e. this is the case only &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 21a:17">Ber. 21ᵃ</cite> bot. (<he>הוה אמינא</he>) <he>הנ״מ יחיד ויחיד</he> I might have thought this refers only to &c.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 15a:5">Ib. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>והנ״מ לק״ש</he> but this applies only to &c.; a. v. fr.—<he>מנא הני מילי</he>, v. <cite ref="M01699"><he>מְנָא</he> II</cite>.—Emphatic. <he>הַנָּא</he>, <cite ref="E00667"><he>הַנָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:5">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>הנה טבא וכ׳</he> is this (slave) good? Is the omen favorable?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:11">Yalk. ib. 145</cite> <he>הא טב וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
